Looped capital with lower horizontal foot: \mathscr{L}. The typeface alternatives \mathcal{L} or \Phi are recorded where the local pen shape does not separate them. The same recurring stem/loop/foot is not silently renamed at a folder boundary.

Scans006 (parenthesis), 008(b), 009 (support formula) have a closed loop and stem without a clear L foot. \Phi remains first locally with alternatives; these are not forced into the regular family glyph.

\mathcal F denotes the cursive collection sign, usually a left middle bar and hooked descending stem; \mathscr F remains a style alternative. The scan025 form is \unsure{\mathcal F|\mathcal J}, compared directly with scan011. Plain F,G,H denote individual figures. M is the multistrate letter.
Angular looped capital P: \mathcal P, with \mathscr P or \mathfrak P when not distinguishable by the ink. Plain L is kept for the ambient set except at explicitly doubtful occurrences.

\partial A and A^\circ. The boundary sign ranges from a rounded left hook to an angular head joined near A, with the same lower loop. The two variants coexist on scan002; the scan018 \delta encoding in C is therefore harmonized to \partial. The circle is small and open, not a zero.
\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta,\eta are retained. Eta has a descending right stroke; it is not silently made epsilon. The label delta is distinct in role from the consistently encoded boundary sign.

\subset is the plain open inclusion sign; no strictness is inferred by adding a slash or inequality mark. \subsetneq appears only where the extra lower slant is drawn. \leq denotes the subfigure order. These symbols do not by themselves repair quantifier ranges in the text.
F\ll G has two angled strokes. F\preccurlyeq G has a curved two-part comparison with a lower line; the scan025 sign is resolved from C’s preccurlyeq/preceq doubt. It is not made identical to \leq.

Primes, stars, circles and overwritten letters are kept separately; ambiguous old marks remain in \deleted{\unsure{…}}. F_A uses a subscript. G^A has an upper A replacing a lower A on scan020. No added prime is inferred from a proof.
Normally |F| or |\mathscr L|. Curved or mismatched right delimiters are retained literally or with \unsure; they are not automatically balanced as mathematical brackets.
002 beta/gamma; 006 Boolean paragraph; 008 final formula; 017 final display
\forall and \exists are retained where visible, including overwritten small letters and the doubled strokes at scan020. A visually absent quantifier is not supplied from a witness.

\varnothing/\emptyset reproduce the slashed-loop empty sign. Short parallel strokes and a crossing stroke written vertically between A^\circ and the empty sign, or between |F| and a union, are laid out vertically rather than silently converted to prose.
\cup,\bigcup and \bigsqcup are distinguished where the ink distinguishes them. The repeated unions in the scan015 boundary formula and the nested singleton braces on scans013–015 are literal.
\widehat L has an actual roof. Overbars, the inserted bar over U, int/ext and the irregular final comparison on scan017 are retained without completing a standard regular-open formula.

Pointed arrowheads, hooks and blunt horizontal strokes are distinguished. Scan025 S-to-T bears a faint i; p and q sit inside the square and surj outside. T-to-L has the custom shallow left hook and short upstroke at the right. p:S-I and q:T-J below are blunt strokes; J\prime to \varphi^{-1}(J\prime) has a head, without a mapsto stem.
Paired short strokes are ``…\'\'. A prose = is retained as =, including lui-= and =s; expansions are confined to the abbreviation list.

Live words above a cancellation are \inserted; crossed words remain \deleted, including recoverable letters beneath replacements. Single/double rules use \uline/\uuline. Heavy overlapping cancellations remain doubtful even when one can anticipate the sentence.
